message: URGENT: Your account has been temporarily suspended. Verify your identity immediately at https://secure-example.com/verify-account or your account may be permanently disabled.
label: PHISHING
reason: Creates urgency and fear. Claims account suspension. Requests identity verification. Uses a suspicious generic security domain. Attempts to make the user act immediately.
recommended_action: Do not click the link or enter credentials. Verify account status by navigating directly to the official website.

message: Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a ₹50,000 reward. Claim your prize by providing your details through the following verification page: https://reward-example.net/claim
label: SCAM
reason: Unexpected prize. Financial incentive. Requests personal information. Uses a generic reward domain.
recommended_action: Ignore and delete. Legitimate organizations do not distribute random cash prizes via unsolicited links.

message: Security Alert: We detected unusual activity on your bank account. Confirm your account information immediately to prevent further restrictions.
label: PHISHING
reason: Impersonates a financial/security service. Creates fear. Requests account information. Uses vague language instead of identifying a verifiable bank contact.
recommended_action: Contact your bank directly using the phone number on the back of your card.

message: Your university portal account requires verification. Please log in through https://student-verification-example.com before today's deadline.
label: PHISHING
reason: Impersonates an educational institution. Creates a deadline. Requests login activity. Domain does not clearly belong to the institution.
recommended_action: Do not click the link. Log in directly via your university's official student portal.

message: Microsoft Security: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue accessing your documents: https://office-login-example.net
label: PHISHING
reason: Uses a recognizable company name. Requests login. Uses a suspicious domain that does not clearly belong to Microsoft.
recommended_action: Do not sign in. Access Microsoft Office directly via office.com.

message: Hey, I'm setting up your account. You should receive a verification code shortly. Send the code to me when it arrives.
label: SOCIAL_ENGINEERING
reason: Attempts to obtain a one-time verification code. The sender provides insufficient context. The request could allow account takeover.
recommended_action: Do NOT share the code. Verification codes are for your eyes only.

message: Your package could not be delivered because your address is incomplete. Update your delivery information here: https://delivery-example.net/update
label: PHISHING
reason: Uses a common delivery-service impersonation pattern. Creates a problem requiring action. Requests information.
recommended_action: Check the delivery status on the official courier's website using your original tracking number.

message: IT Department: We are performing a security audit. Please send your username and password to this email so we can verify your account.
label: PHISHING
reason: Requests credentials directly. Legitimate IT departments should not normally request passwords through ordinary messages.
recommended_action: Do not reply. Report this message to your actual IT department.

message: Your account needs verification: https://google.com.security-example.net/login
label: MALICIOUS_LINK
reason: The important domain is security-example.net. The presence of google.com is part of the hostname/subdomain and does NOT mean the URL belongs to Google.
recommended_action: Do not visit the link. The URL is deceptive.

message: Please verify your student account: https://accounts-university-example.net/gitam/login
label: PHISHING
reason: Uses an institution-related keyword. Requests login. Domain does not establish legitimate institutional ownership.
recommended_action: Do not log in. Go to the official university website to verify.

message: Hey, are you coming to the library after class?
label: SAFE
reason: No credential request. No suspicious link. Normal interpersonal communication.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: The Python assignment is due tomorrow. Don't forget to submit it.
label: SAFE
reason: Normal academic communication with no suspicious behavior.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: Our project meeting is at 5 PM in Lab 204. Please bring your laptop.
label: SAFE
reason: No phishing indicators.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: Remember to use a strong password and enable multi-factor authentication on your accounts.
label: SAFE
reason: The message discusses security but does not request credentials or force the user to visit a suspicious website.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: I pushed the latest changes to our GitHub repository. Please review the pull request when you have time.
label: SAFE
reason: Normal software-development communication.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: We noticed a login to your account from a new device. If this wasn't you, please open the official application and review your recent activity.
label: SAFE
reason: Discusses a security event, but does not request a password or contain a suspicious link. Directs user to the official app.
recommended_action: Open the official app to check your activity.

message: Please review the documentation at https://example.com/docs/security
label: SAFE
reason: A URL alone does not make a message malicious. Domain is not malicious and context is normal.
recommended_action: Safe to view.

message: URGENT: The classroom has changed to Room 204. Please arrive before the 10 AM lecture.
label: SAFE
reason: Contains URGENT, but urgency alone is not phishing. No credential or financial requests.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: Our cybersecurity lecture today covers password managers and MFA.
label: SAFE
reason: Contains cybersecurity-related keywords but does not attempt to steal credentials.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: Can you send me your student portal username and password? I need to check something for the project.
label: SOCIAL_ENGINEERING
reason: Requests credentials. Uses a plausible interpersonal excuse. Attempts to normalize credential sharing.
recommended_action: Do not share your credentials.

message: https://paypal.com.security-example.net/login
label: MALICIOUS_LINK
reason: The registrable domain is security-example.net, NOT paypal.com. The attacker is using a trusted brand name as part of the hostname.
recommended_action: Do not click the link.

message: https://paypa1-example.net/login
label: MALICIOUS_LINK
reason: Uses a visually similar brand concept. Attempts to imitate a trusted service. Login path increases risk.
recommended_action: Do not click the link.

message: Your account requires verification. Visit http://192.0.2.10/login
label: MALICIOUS_LINK
reason: Authentication page hosted directly on an IP address. HTTP instead of HTTPS. Account-verification context.
recommended_action: Do not visit or enter credentials.

message: Please log in to verify your account: http://example.net/login
label: SUSPICIOUS
reason: Login request. Uses HTTP rather than HTTPS. Generic domain.
recommended_action: Proceed with extreme caution. Do not submit passwords.

message: This is the university administration office. Your account has been selected for an important verification process. Send your student ID and login details immediately.
label: PHISHING
reason: Authority impersonation. Urgency. Requests sensitive information. Uses institutional trust.
recommended_action: Do not reply. Report to your university IT.

message: Hey, I'm having trouble accessing my account. Can you forward me the verification code you receive? It's really important.
label: SOCIAL_ENGINEERING
reason: Requests verification code. Uses friendship/trust. Creates urgency. Could facilitate account takeover.
recommended_action: Do not share the code. Contact your friend through another channel to verify.

message: I need the payment completed within the next 10 minutes or your registration will be cancelled. Pay using the link below.
label: PHISHING
reason: Strong time pressure. Financial transaction. Threat of cancellation. Link-based payment request.
recommended_action: Do not pay via the link. Log in directly to the service provider.

message: Warning: Never share your password or OTP with anyone. Cybercriminals may send fake verification messages to steal your account.
label: SAFE
reason: Educational message containing phishing-related keywords but no malicious intent.
recommended_action: No action required.

message: Hi, I need you to complete a quick step regarding your account. Use the page below and finish the process before access is affected. https://account-check-example.net/process
label: PHISHING
reason: Creates implied pressure. References account access. Requests external action. Domain is generic.
recommended_action: Do not click the link. Verify account status directly.

message: Our cybersecurity club is conducting a phishing-awareness workshop today. We will demonstrate how fake login pages work. Please attend Lab 3 at 4 PM.
label: SAFE
reason: Contains phishing-related keywords but the context is clearly educational.
recommended_action: No action required.
